notes: On 1h, every session setting landed inside the luck band after 20 candles. The London cross down through the previous low gave 1,140 entries and ended 0.14% behind random, inside a band of -0.23% to 0.24%. The only coin-level result was BTC on the weekday cross above the previous day's high. It beat random by 0.20%, but only because of signals on Jan 5–7, 2021, and without them it is chance.

On 4h, price closing above the previous day's high was followed by moves 0.51% ahead of random entries after 20 candles, above the band's 0.36%. It held without its strongest stretch, between Aug 10 and Sep 9, 2021. It showed at 10 and 100 candles but not at 50. SOL carried most of it at 0.97%, and ETH sat inside the band.

The split by trend narrows that result. In uptrends the 4h gap was 0.52%, but it disappears without the stretch between Aug 10 and Sep 9, 2021. In downtrends it was 0.19%, inside the band. The cross up through the previous day's high fires about four and a half times less often than holding above it. In uptrends it beat random by 0.69%, held without its strongest stretch on Dec 19–22, 2023, and in downtrends it trailed random by 0.03%, inside the band.

Single stretches produced the negative results. On 4h, entries as price crossed down through the London previous low trailed random by 0.75%, just past the band's -0.70%. That rests on two entries on Apr 10–12, 2024, and without them it is chance. Price above the London midpoint on 4h looked worse in downtrends only because of signals on Nov 10–11, 2022, during the FTX collapse.

On daily, price above the previous day's high gave only 28 separate moves, under the 30 needed for a verdict. Its 2.56% gap comes from one long run between Dec 14, 2020 and Nov 4, 2021, and in downtrends it showed nothing.

On a long DCA bot, a session high or low cross on 1h gives no better start than a random candle, so leave it out. The one shape worth testing is 4h price above the previous day's high, and mostly while the pair closes above its 200-day SMA. Use it as a filter beside your own entry condition, not as the entry itself. It showed at 10 and 20 candles but not at 50, so keep the take profit within that reach instead of waiting for DCA orders to work through a long move.
